# `use-after-release`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a visible use of an allocation after its matching release.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

The value no longer refers to live storage, so reads and writes are invalid.

## When it fires

It applies to ordered uses and releases in the same conservatively analyzed
scope.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn make(gpa: std.mem.Allocator) !void {
    const buf = try gpa.alloc(u8, 8);
    gpa.free(buf);
    buf[0] = 1;
}
```
